_comment: Anchor points (lon, lat) round each port, nearest first (the sides before straight out in front) and none in the funnel in front of the harbour mouth: built by tools/build_anchorages.gd. all: each clear of land as far as the longest ship can swing about it (8.8 nm), and that far and a little more from the others; small: the same for ships up to small_length dock units long (7.1 nm).
